# Environment

`requirements.txt` — Python. `R_packages.txt` — R.

Both were generated by scanning every `import` in the shipped `.py` files and every
`library()` / `require()` / `pkg::` call in the shipped `.R` files, so they cover what
the code actually loads rather than what was remembered.

Where the manuscript Methods names a version, that version is pinned: it is what
produced the published results. Where it does not, the version listed is the one in
the authors' environment at the time of submission, which post-dates the analysis for
some packages. Those are floors, not guarantees.

Most per-figure renderers need only the plotting and data-manipulation packages. The
heavy dependencies (`scanpy`, `anndata`, `h5py`, `cellxgene-census`, `tiledbsoma`,
`monocle3`, `CellChat`) are required only by builder scripts that read the large
AnnData objects or query external censuses; those objects are not shipped and the
scripts that need them are listed as gated in `../README_REPRODUCIBILITY.md`.
